- [Codex priority P2 (P0 highest)] Respect option-value positions when checking glob arguments — scripts/unvalidated-negative-result-check.py:335-337

The expansion is a pattern argument, not an option; following the suggested `./` replacement would change the pattern. Parse option-value positions before classifying expansions, and distinguish a `--` consumed as an option value from an actual option terminator.

A deterministic fake-/proc reproduction returns `[]` while the orphan remains alive, allowing `run_one_suite` to delete its TMPDIR.
